title: Simple Design System
author: Figma
about: Introducing the Simple Design System: A UI kit built by Figma to help you get started faster using pre-built examples and components. This library covers Figma’s best practices for building a basic design system, and includes a full range of resources to enable core design use cases – like designing for web, mobile, and more.
features: Examples – Full screen mockups that can be inserted into your file to go from blank page to polished designs quickly
400+ components, backed by code (Code Connect available on paid plans only)
Styles and variables support, including light and dark mode
note: The code is available to view on Figma's GitHub account. The repository contains icons, variables, and components as well as useful scripts for getting started with Code Connect.

title: Material UI for Figma (and MUI X)
author: MUI
about: Material UI components in Figma so designers and developers can communicate and iterate more efficiently. This free community version covers the Material UI and MUI X (advanced components like the Data Grid) libraries, built and maintained by the MUI team.
features: Hundreds of components matching Material UI's own design, plus some beyond Material Design's own coverage
Shared terminology with the React library for props, variables, and design tokens — so designers and engineers speak the same language
Every component available with no customization limits in this free version
note: This is the free Community edition; MUI also sells a paid version with more customizable component variants. Design-kit releases are tracked on MUI's own GitHub (mui/mui-design-kits).
